steps.title: Puzzle pieces
steps.body: Blocks to push and pull, switches to step on, hit or pull, doors with locks, keys, a map and a compass: they are under Starter pack › Puzzle pieces, and each works by itself. Logic only says what happens next.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: A block and a switch
steps.body: Click Push block, then click the ground 3 studs in front of the start. Then click Weight switch and put it right behind the block, so one shove slides the block onto it. A weight switch is down only while something heavy stands on it: the block is heavy enough, you alone are not.
steps.task: Place a Push block, and a Weight switch just past it.

steps.title: The gate it opens
steps.body: Place a Barred gate further on. Then under Scripts and cutscenes, Use… “Switch opens a gate”: set Switch to Weight switch and Make it. The logic is two lines: On switch to on opens the gate, to off shuts it.
steps.task: Place a Barred gate and make “Switch opens a gate” with the Weight switch.

steps.title: Push it on
steps.body: Press Play and walk up to the block. Hold Action (E · Grab) and walk (W) into it: the hero leans in and the block slides two studs onto the switch, the hero walking behind. The switch goes down and the gate opens. (Walk into it without E and you climb on top instead.)
steps.task: Press Play, hold E and push the block onto the switch.

steps.title: Pull it back
steps.body: Go round to the start side of the block and face it: the Action button says Grab. Hold Action (E) and step back (S): the hero sits back and pulls, the block comes with you, off the switch, and the gate shuts again.
steps.task: Grab the block and pull it off the switch.

steps.title: A crystal on a timer
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Crystal switch to the right of the start, then double-click its card to open it in the Asset studio. Under Puzzle › Switch, choose Timed and set 8 seconds: hit, it stays on for 8 seconds, ticking.
steps.task: Place a Crystal switch and make it Timed.

steps.title: Hit it
steps.body: Press Play, walk to the crystal and swing your sword at it (F). It turns red and ticks; after 8 seconds it goes back. An arrow, a boomerang or a bomb will do the same once you have them.
steps.task: Press Play and hit the crystal.

steps.title: A door and its key
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Locked door to the left, and a Small chest near the start: opening it gives a small key. The door opens with a small key from this map, and uses it up.
steps.task: Place a Locked door and a Small chest.

steps.title: Make it a dungeon
steps.body: In the Map tab on the right, tick This map is a dungeon. Its keys now open only its own doors, the minimap shows only where you have been until you find the Dungeon map, and the HUD counts your small keys.
steps.task: Tick This map is a dungeon (Map tab).

steps.title: Open the chest, then the door
steps.body: Press Play. Open the chest (Action): a small key, and the HUD shows 🗝 1. Walk to the door and press Action: it unlocks and the key is used up. With no key it would only say it is locked.
steps.task: Press Play, open the chest, then the door.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You pushed (with Grab) and pulled a block onto a weight switch that opens a gate, timed a crystal switch and hit it, and opened a locked door with a key from a chest in a dungeon. The Boss door, Boss key, Dungeon map and Compass work the same way. Make your own in the Asset studio under Puzzle.
